title: 第一卷 正文第9章 收获第一卷 正文第10章 生死对决
content_zh:
楚江越想越兴奋，仿佛已经看到自己取代楚山，成为风云城楚家分支家主时的场景。
“孽障，纳命来吧！”
楚江暴喝一声，灵师一重天后期的修为全力爆发，猛烈的气势犹如狂风一般，横扫八方。
他猛地一跺脚，如同炮弹一般，全力攻向楚凌天。
虽然楚凌天刚才伤了他，但他认为，那是他轻敌导致的。
楚凌天的修为虽然达到了灵师一重天，但从其爆发出气息来看，只是刚刚踏入灵师一重天初期罢了。而他的修为，则达到了灵师一重天后期。只要他认真起来，对付楚凌天绰绰有余。
“来得好！”楚凌天眼中不仅没有丝毫惧色，反而战意滔天。
他本就想找一头弱一点的二阶低级妖兽练练手，现在省的去妖兽了，用楚江来练手，正好合适。
楚凌天脚踏《游身步》，化作一道残影，主动朝着楚江攻去。
转眼间，两人便战在一起。
“嘭！嘭！嘭！”
一连串对轰声响起。
虽然楚凌天的修为，比楚江弱一丝。但他已将《游身步》修炼至圆满之境，移动速度极快。而楚江只是将《游身步》修炼至大成之境而已。
几个回合下来，楚凌天毫发无损，但楚江却中了数记重拳，使得伤上加伤。
“该死！楚凌天怎么会把《游身步》修炼至圆满之境！”楚江满脸惊怒。
若继续这样下去，他的伤势只会越来越重。
楚江咬了咬牙，硬抗了楚凌天一记重拳，身形后撤，与其拉开距离。
“孽障，本长老承认小看你了。但今日，你必死！”楚江咬牙切齿道。
“猛虎爪！”
楚江暴喝一声，动用了最强杀招。

作为风云城楚家分支的三长老，他已将《猛虎爪》修炼至大成之境，威力比楚云施展的《猛虎爪》强大十倍！
全力爆发之下，就算是与他同阶的修士都挡不住。
只见楚江右手五指弯曲，催动体内灵力凝聚于手爪之上，撕裂空气，朝着楚凌天狠狠抓去！
“吼！”
一道霸气十足的虎啸声，响彻云霄！
仔细望去，楚江的右爪之上，竟然浮现出一道淡淡的虎爪虚影，散发出凌厉之意！威力惊人！
“三长老，你若是将《猛虎爪》修炼至圆满之境，或许能胜过我。但可惜，你只将它修炼至大成之境。所以今日，该死的人是你！”
话音落下，楚凌天右手并掌，全力拍出。
“火云掌！”
随着楚凌天右掌的拍出，四周空气剧烈震荡，一道直径一米的巨大掌印，瞬间凝聚而出，带着刚猛霸道的力量，压爆空气，狠狠拍向楚江。
“嘭！”
一道沉闷的对轰声响起，虎爪虚影与掌印在半空中相撞。
content_en:
The more Chu Jiang thought about it, the more excited he became, as if he had already seen the scene when he replaced Chu Shan and became the head of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City.
"You evildoer, come and accept your fate!"
Chu Jiang shouted loudly, and the spiritual master's cultivation in the late stage of the first level exploded with all his strength, and the fierce momentum was like a strong wind, sweeping in all directions.
He stamped his feet suddenly, like a cannonball, attacking Chu Lingtian with all his strength.
Although Chu Lingtian had hurt him just now, he believed that it was because he underestimated the enemy.
Although Chu Lingtian's cultivation level has reached the first level of the spiritual master, judging from his burst of aura, he has just entered the early stage of the first level of the spiritual master. And his cultivation level has reached the late stage of the first level of spiritual master. As long as he takes it seriously, he can deal with Chu Lingtian more than enough.
"Well done!" Not only did Chu Lingtian's eyes show no fear, but he was filled with fighting spirit.
He originally wanted to find a weaker second-level low-level monster to practice with, but now that he could save the monster, Chu Jiang was just right for him to practice with.
Chu Lingtian stepped on the "Swimming Step" and turned into an afterimage, taking the initiative to attack Chu Jiang.
In a blink of an eye, the two were fighting together.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
A series of roars sounded.
Although Chu Lingtian's cultivation level is slightly weaker than Chu Jiang's. But he has practiced "Wandering Step" to perfection and can move extremely fast. And Chu Jiang just practiced "Wandering Body Step" to the state of great success.
After several rounds, Chu Lingtian was unscathed, but Chu Jiang was hit by several heavy punches, causing more injuries.
"Damn it! How could Chu Lingtian cultivate the "Swimming Body Step" to perfection!" Chu Jiang's face was full of shock and anger.
If he continues like this, his injuries will only get worse.
Chu Jiang gritted his teeth, resisted Chu Lingtian's heavy punch, and retreated to distance himself from him.
"Nie Zhan, I admit that I underestimated you. But today, you will die!" Chu Jiang gritted his teeth.
"Tiger Claw!"
Chu Jiang shouted loudly and used his strongest killing move.
As the third elder of the Chu family branch in Fengyun City, he has cultivated the "Tiger Claw" to a great level, which is ten times more powerful than the "Tiger Claw" used by Chu Yun!
When he exploded with all his strength, even monks of the same level as him couldn't stop him.
I saw the five fingers of Chu Jiang's right hand bending, urging the spiritual power in his body to condense on his claws, tearing the air, and grabbing Chu Lingtian fiercely!
"Roar!"
A domineering tiger roar echoed through the sky!
Looking carefully, a faint shadow of a tiger claw appeared on Chu Jiang's right paw, exuding a fierce meaning! Amazing power!
"Third Elder, if you cultivated "Tiger Claw" to the state of perfection, you might be able to defeat me. But unfortunately, you only cultivated it to the state of Dacheng. So today, you are the one who deserves to die!"
After the words fell, Chu Lingtian put his right hands together and struck out with all his strength.
"Fire Cloud Palm!"
As Chu Lingtian's right palm was slapped, the surrounding air shook violently, and a huge palm print with a diameter of one meter condensed out instantly. With fierce and domineering power, it exploded the air and slapped Chu Jiang fiercely.
"Bang!"
A dull roar sounded, and the phantom of the tiger's claws and the palm prints collided in mid-air.
